records.title: Althöfer · Does the 9n+1 orbit from 1 diverge?
records.ppl_snapshot_label: Independent · Althöfer Collatz prizes Verified open

offers.sponsor: Ingo Althöfer
offers.condition: Resolve whether the accelerated 9n+1 orbit starting at 1 tends to infinity. First qualifying solution only; correct computer-assisted proofs accepted; no exact cutoff time is given.

records.title: Althöfer · A divergent Xn+1 orbit
records.ppl_snapshot_label: Independent · Althöfer Collatz prizes Verified open

offers.sponsor: Ingo Althöfer
offers.condition: Resolve whether some odd X ≥ 5 and positive odd start give an accelerated Xn+1 orbit tending to infinity. First qualifying solution only; correct computer-assisted proofs accepted; no exact cutoff time is given.

records.title: Althöfer · Optimal-play 3n±1 game
records.ppl_snapshot_label: Independent · Althöfer Collatz prizes Verified open

offers.sponsor: Ingo Althöfer
offers.condition: Prove termination at 1 from every positive odd start under optimal alternating play. The sponsor explicitly reaffirmed the open prize after a submitted approach had gaps. First qualifying solution only; correct computer-assisted proofs accepted; no exact cutoff time is given.

records.title: Althöfer · Stochastic ± Collatz convergence
records.ppl_snapshot_label: Independent · Althöfer Collatz prizes Verified open

offers.sponsor: Ingo Althöfer
offers.condition: Prove almost-sure arrival at 1 from every positive odd start, using independent fair choices of odd(3n+1) and odd(3n−1). First qualifying solution only; correct computer-assisted proofs accepted; no exact cutoff time is given.
